stories.title: AI claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis — and a human did, too
stories.explanation: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims to have found a Lean-compilable solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis. If verified, this would be a major achievement in mathematics, potentially aided by AI.

stories.title: Researcher plants 2m canaries into the AI supply chain. A privacy disaster surfaced.
stories.explanation: A researcher planted 2 million digital tripwires in AI service requests, revealing that sensitive data entrusted to AI routers leaks extensively. This experiment highlights a significant privacy disaster within the AI supply chain.

stories.title: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?
stories.explanation: Anthropic went public on the Nasdaq, becoming one of the most valuable companies. This event raises questions about the company's safety-first mission and the balance between idealism and capitalism in the AI industry.

stories.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
stories.explanation: OpenAI is addressing adversarial distillation, where bad actors reproduce model capabilities without safeguards, through a layered approach combining model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement. This aims to protect against unauthorized capability extraction and strengthen industry-wide defenses.

stories.title: Google rolls out new search homepage with AI chat history and no search button
stories.explanation: Google is rolling out a redesigned search homepage that integrates AI chat history and removes the dedicated search button. This makes AI tools more accessible directly from the search page, evolving the flagship search experience into an AI experience.

stories.title: How Google Duplex evolved to also call businesses for you in Gemini
stories.explanation: Google Duplex, which pioneered natural voice conversations between AI and local businesses, is now integrated into Tasks in Gemini to complete tasks like making dinner reservations or booking appointments. This integration leverages AI for high-quality speech understanding, contextual reasoning, and speech synthesis.

stories.title: The Outages Are Just Getting Started
stories.explanation: AI is accelerating vulnerability discovery and exploitation, pressuring companies to patch systems faster and contributing to real-world tech failures. This highlights the increasing impact of AI on cybersecurity dynamics and system stability.

stories.title: Meta reconsiders 2030 net-zero goal amid record emissions from AI data centers
stories.explanation: Meta is re-evaluating its 2030 net-zero emissions goal due to record greenhouse gas emissions from its AI data centers. This reflects the unexpected rapid growth in demand for AI infrastructure and its environmental impact.

stories.title: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update
stories.explanation: A new report from METR indicates that some AI capabilities continue to improve exponentially, but models show weaknesses in tasks requiring judgment compared to coding. This updates understanding of AI progress and limitations.

stories.title: The fallout from Nvidia’s Jensen Huang scandal continues
stories.explanation: Nvidia reported strong earnings despite the fallout from Jensen Huang's ouster and announced it would stop selling H200 chips in China. This highlights Nvidia's continued financial strength and strategic adjustments in the AI chip market.
